ui.InputGroupClearButton: Rendered inside the SearchInput and NumberFilter stories, which show its states.
ui.LocaleProvider: Context provider with no output of its own.
ui.Portal: Moves its children elsewhere in the document and has no output of its own.
ui.TreeDragPreview: An alias of DragPreview, which has its own stories.

pages.AuthSuccess: Building block of the ForgotPasswordPage and ResetPasswordPage success stories.
pages.PasswordRulesPopover: Building block of the ResetPasswordPage stories.
